items.title: Golden Light on Freckled Skin
items.scene: Extreme close-up of a woman in her 30s with Northern European features: short strawberry-blonde pixie cut, pale freckled skin with real pores and faint laugh lines at the eye. She sits by the window of a private hotel suite, eyes half-closed, a small natural smile, two fingertips resting lightly on her cheekbone. Low golden-hour sun rakes across her skin and catches fine peach fuzz. Her face fills the right half of the frame from brow to jaw; on the left, the wide lens reveals a softly blurred room: terracotta plaster wall, sand linen curtains, a sand-coloured bedspread. She wears a rust linen shirt with an open collar. Warm, quiet, unhurried mood.

items.title: Porcelain Bridge on Black Slate
items.scene: Eye-level macro product shot, no people. A rough, hand-split black slate stone sits in the centre of the frame. On it rests a three-unit, tooth-coloured ceramic dental bridge. Just in front of it and slightly to the left stand two single porcelain crowns, one tilted to show its smooth, hollow inner shape. A single narrow spotlight from directly above drops a tight cone of light onto the pieces. Their glossy, enamel-like surfaces catch crisp white highlights and show soft translucent ivory edges, and the grain and chipped edge of the slate glint faintly. Everything beyond the stone falls into pitch-black darkness. Focus is very shallow: the front crown is razor-sharp and the bridge softens slightly behind it. The mood is precise, crafted and quietly premium, like a jewellery photograph.

items.title: The Clear Jaw Model
items.scene: By a tall steel-framed window in a calm, modern implant clinic with pale grey micro-cement walls, an implant dentist hands a patient a clear acrylic model of a lower jaw. She is Ukrainian, in her 30s, with a long dark braid over one shoulder, and wears coral scrubs. He is Turkish, in his 60s, bald with a neat grey goatee, and wears a navy polo shirt. Inside the see-through jawbone, four small titanium implant posts sit beneath a fixed tooth-coloured bridge. He holds the model up in both hands and tilts it toward the light, eyebrows raised with curiosity. She smiles and points toward the posts with an open hand. Behind them a coral armchair is softly blurred. Soft late-morning daylight; open, curious, reassuring.

items.title: Burgundy Studio, Easy Smile
items.scene: Slightly low-angle studio portrait of a Turkish man in his 50s against a seamless deep burgundy backdrop. Salt-and-pepper hair swept back, a closely trimmed grey beard, warm brown eyes with crow's feet. He wears a cream band-collar linen shirt with the top button open. Head turned three-quarters and chin lifted a little, he breaks into a relaxed, natural smile that shows his teeth, as if reacting to a joke off-camera. A single hard light from the side sculpts one half of his face; the other half falls into deep shadow that melts into the burgundy. Crisp detail in skin texture and beard. Grounded, confident, quietly elegant.

items.title: Quiet Chat Before the Cleaning
items.scene: A low, wide view from the foot of an aubergine dental chair in a small, quiet hygiene room. A Moroccan man in his late 20s lies fully reclined and relaxed. His legs in dark jeans lead along the chair to his face, and his hands are folded loosely on a bottle-green corduroy overshirt under a plain lilac paper bib. He has short curly black hair and a thin moustache, his mouth is closed, and he turns his eyes calmly toward the hygienist. She sits on a saddle stool at the head of the chair. She is an Irish dental hygienist in her 60s with rosy, freckled skin and short silver curls, and she wears aubergine scrubs and lilac gloves, with magnifying loupes pushed up on her forehead. Forearms on her knees, she chats softly before she begins. Butter-yellow tiles glow behind them. The mood is calm and trusting.

An Indian endodontist in his early 60s, clean-shaven, with thick silver hair under a graphite scrub cap and wearing graphite-grey scrubs, leans into the binocular eyepieces of a large unbranded dental operating microscope. His pale-grey gloved hands rest on its side handles, and his face is calm and absorbed in three-quarter profile. items.title: Balcony Breeze, Jaw at Ease
items.scene: A South Asian woman in her early 40s leans on the slim dusty-blue metal railing of a high-rise apartment balcony on a hazy late afternoon. She has warm brown skin with natural texture and dark hair with a few silver threads gathered in a low bun, and loose strands lift in the breeze. She wears a peach linen blouse with the sleeves pushed up. Her elbow rests on the rail and the back of her loosely curled fingers sits lightly under her chin. Her jaw is soft and unclenched, her lips parted in an easy smile as she looks out over the city. The shot is a close three-quarter profile, with her jawline clean against a pale sky. Below her, rooftops and towers dissolve into a peach and dusty-blue haze. Light, free, at ease.

items.title: Sunrise Yawn at the Tent

Beyond him, layered ridges and a fog-filled blue valley catch the first sun. Fresh, easy, awake.

items.title: Mid-Spin at the Wedding
items.scene: A candid moment on the dance floor of a night-time wedding reception in a garden marquee. Joyful, spontaneous, alive.

items.title: Plaster Profile in Lilac Studio
items.scene: A side-on, eye-level close-up in a sculptor's studio, no people. items.title: Starlings Over the Reed Hide
items.scene: A late winter afternoon inside a small wooden birdwatching hide by a reed bed. A Danish man in his 60s, with thick white hair and a short white beard, leans on the sill of the long open viewing slot. items.scene: Medium shot in a community ceramics studio inside an old brick workshop. Two Polish sisters in their 50s share one electric pottery wheel and burst out laughing as the rim of their wet clay bowl wobbles. The seated sister, with very short cropped silver hair and a striped ink-blue-and-white Breton top, cups the spinning bowl in both clay-slicked hands. Her sister, with a long greying dark-blonde braid and a rolled-sleeve indigo cotton shirt, leans in from the side, one muddy fingertip steadying the rim. Both wear heavy ink-blue canvas aprons streaked with clay. Behind them, wooden shelves hold rows of unfired grey bowls. Warm late-afternoon light slants through a dusty steel-framed window, catching floating clay dust. Joyful, tactile, together.

items.title: Sketching Through the Afternoon
items.scene: Medium shot of a Black man in his 30s with dark brown skin, shoulder-length locs gathered at the nape and a short trimmed beard. He sits sideways in a white recliner in a sun-filled haematology day-treatment lounge. Plain white over-ear headphones rest on his head. He wears a loose apricot linen overshirt over a white long-sleeve tee and grey trousers. Absorbed and relaxed, he pencils the rooftops outside into a sketchbook propped on his knee: drawing only, no writing. Bright afternoon sun pours through a tall window with half-drawn apricot curtains and throws crisp window-frame shadows across the white wall. In the right foreground, a slim infusion stand shows only as a soft, out-of-focus vertical blur. Calm, absorbed, time well spent.

items.title: Dermatoscope Check, Plum and Cobalt
items.scene: A discreet two-shot in a bright, minimalist dermatology examination room. A South Asian woman in her late 20s sits on a plum-upholstered examination chair. Her long dark hair is in a low side braid, and she wears a plum corduroy overshirt over a white T-shirt. Turned three-quarters toward the light, she lifts her chin slightly and gives a calm, relaxed half-smile. Facing her on a low rolling stool, in profile, an Ethiopian-German dermatologist in her 40s holds a slim handheld dermatoscope close to the edge of the woman's jaw, and its tiny ring light glows. The dermatologist has short cropped natural hair and wears cobalt-blue scrubs and white gloves. Behind them are cool white walls, a white instrument cart with its drawers closed, and a translucent white blind that softens the morning light. The mood is respectful, attentive and unhurried.

items.title: Violet Welcome at the Scanner
items.scene: Symmetrical one-point perspective view straight into a modern CT room, taken from the doorway at chest height. The plain white ring of the CT scanner sits exactly in the centre, and its padded table runs toward the camera along the central axis. At the table's near end, a Latin American radiographer in her mid-20s steadies the elbow of a South Asian man in his 70s as he sits on the table edge, ready to lie back. She has warm golden-brown skin, a high black ponytail and violet scrubs. He has white side-parted hair and round dark-framed glasses, and wears a light-grey crew-neck sweatshirt and dark trousers. His shoes stand neatly on the floor, and he smiles at something she says. Matching violet cabinet walls frame both sides. A large flat ceiling panel gives cool, even white light. Orderly, calm, welcoming.

items.title: Hay Dust and a Chestnut Horse
items.scene: A stable yard in the late afternoon. A Latin American woman in her mid-20s, with warm tan skin and a long dark-brown ponytail, stands at a weathered timber half-door and strokes the nose of a chestnut horse with a white blaze, laughing as it nuzzles her palm. She wears a faded cornflower-blue cotton work shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, dark brown riding breeches and worn tan boots. Her other arm rests on top of the half-door, and a small round skin-coloured plaster on the inside of that forearm hints at a recent allergy test. Behind them, low sun pours through the open barn door and backlights drifting hay dust into a golden haze over stacked bales and a coiled rope halter. Relaxed, carefree, everyday.

Two canvas sun hats and a small sky-blue daypack lie between them, ready for a trip. A tall window on the left shows clear blue sky. The mood is cheerful, light and everyday.

items.title: Quiet Pulse at the Window Seat
items.scene: A close two-shot at a deep, low window seat in a quiet internal-medicine consultation room. A Greek man in his late 60s sits sideways on a slate-blue cushion. He has sun-weathered olive skin, swept-back white hair and a thick white moustache, and wears a rust corduroy overshirt with the left sleeve pushed up. Facing him from the other end of the seat, a Japanese internist in his late 40s rests two fingertips on the inside of the man's wrist and counts silently with his eyes lowered. The internist has short greying hair and thin steel glasses, and wears a slate-blue cotton shirt with a stethoscope around his neck. The patient watches him calmly. Cool overcast light falls from the tall window at the side, and the slate-blue walls fade into soft shadow. Quiet, attentive, unhurried.

items.title: Through the Lead Glass
items.scene: Eye-level view from inside the dim control room of an angiography suite, looking out through a broad steel-framed lead-glass window. Sharp in the left foreground, a Greek radiographer in his late 50s sits on a swivel stool at a dark console. He has thick curly salt-and-pepper hair, a clean-shaven face and tortoiseshell glasses, and wears a burnt-amber zip scrub jacket over graphite scrubs. Calm and attentive, he lifts one open palm toward the glass in a small, reassuring wave. Two console monitors stand at the edge of the frame with their matte backs to the camera. Beyond the faintly warm-tinted glass, out of focus, the grey arc of a C-arm curves over the procedure table, where a patient lies under a grey blanket with their head hidden behind the detector. Amber wall wash, cool overhead light. Quiet, watchful care.

items.title: Brothers at the Backyard Grill
items.scene: Two Filipino brothers in their 40s, living donor and recipient, share an easy weekend moment at a charcoal grill in their backyard back home. The camera sits low on the far side of the grill: corn cobs and pepper skewers blur softly in the foreground while thin wisps of smoke curl between us and them. The younger brother, black undercut and light stubble, smoke-grey T-shirt, turns the corn with long steel tongs; the elder, greying hair and thin-rimmed glasses, corn-yellow camp-collar shirt, leans on his shoulder, laughing. Both share the same broad smile. Late-afternoon sun backlights them, rimming hair and smoke; behind them, a grey board fence and translucent banana leaves. Warm, ordinary, brotherly.

items.title: Tiny Grip Through the Porthole
items.scene: Night in a hushed neonatal intensive care unit, seen at incubator height. A West African father in his late 20s, with close-cropped hair and a short neat beard, wears a honey-amber cotton sweatshirt and sits on a low stool beside a closed incubator. One bare hand reaches through its round porthole, and his premature baby's tiny hand curls around his index finger, in sharp focus. The baby is only a soft shape under a mint knitted blanket and cap. critic_summaries:
The round-1 set doesn't solve the client's complaint. It replaces one repeated look with 12 fixed templates. Each template is used 10 or 11 times, and each locks together the same ethnicity, age, palette, setting, framing and light. Shown together on the site, these become 12 recurring photo series with recurring characters, which is the same "same patient, same doctor" problem in new clothes.

The 12 clusters (123 slots in total):
- **A, terracotta macro (11):** freckled Northern European, hotel suite, golden-hour or curtain-gap macro. m872 m752 m860 m873 m901 m913 m925 m938 m950 m964 n501
- **B, teal/white overhead flat-lay (11):** m745 m753 m861 m874 m904 m915 m927 m940 m951 m967 n504
- **C, sage/white riverside (11):** Middle Eastern person in their 70s, old-town promenade, three-quarter back view. m743 m754 m862 m885 m916 m928 m936 m941 m952 m966 n545
- **D, blush/ivory room (10):** Scandinavian person in their 60s, wide room shot, north light or blue hour. m746 m863 m886 m905 m918 m929 m943 m953 m965 m973
- **E, burgundy studio (10):** Turkish person in their 50s, low angle, hard side light. m864 m887 m894 m906 m917 m932 m942 m954 m968 m976
- **F, sky-blue corridor close-up (10):** Balkan person in their 40s. m865 m888 m895 m907 m919 m930 m944 m956 m969 m977
- **G, black-and-white side profile on a train or in an airport (10):** German person in their 30s. m764 m866 m889 m896 m908 m920 m931 m945 m955 m971
- **H, navy/walnut home with negative space (10):** Mediterranean person in their 20s. m755 m867 m890 m897 m902 m909 m921 m946 m957 m970
- **I, over-the-shoulder in a forest-green oak atrium (10):** Georgian man in his 70s. m868 m891 m898 m910 m923 m933 m947 m958 m972 m979
- **J, ochre/slate lake or garden, candid at dawn or dusk (10):** Ukrainian person in their 60s. m869 m892 m899 m911 m922 m934 m948 m959 m975 m978
- **K, charcoal/brass lab duo (10):** Persian person in their 50s. m858 m893 m900 m912 m924 m937 m949 m960 m962 m974
- **L, olive/linen office framed through a doorway (10):** North African person in their 40s. m763 m859 m903 m914 m926 m935 m939 m961 m963 m980

Worst offenders:
- **Recurring characters.** The silver-moustached Georgian man in forest green on the oak staircase appears 9 times. The Persian woman with a silver-streaked bun and brass glasses appears 7 times.
- **Duplicate titles.** m911 and m934 are both "Dawn Walk by the Lake". m977 and m888 are both "Evening Calm on the Ward". m867 and m921 are both "Blue-Hour Rest at Home".
- **Near-identical twins.** m764/m931/m920, m969/m895, m865/m930, m913/m950, m968/m887, m917/m954/m864, and m903/m926/m939/m961.
- **Duplicates on the same page.** On the Plastic Surgery page: m860/m964, m861/m967, m858/m962 and m859/m963. On Medical Aesthetics: m872/m873.
- **Overused motifs:**
  - someone holding a film, bag, tube or slide up to the light (about 11)
  - hands-only macros (9)
  - flat-lays (11)
  - lakes (7) and riverside scenes (8)
  - trains (7)
  - doorway framing (10) and over-the-shoulder shots (10)
  - golden hour (about 16) and blue hour (about 15)

Keepers (one per cluster, unflagged): m872 (A), m940 (B), m743 (C), m746 (D), m968 (E), m969 (F), m971 (G), m897 (H), m958 (I), m899 (J), m937 (K), m763 (L). The other 111 slots are flagged, each with a concrete new scene.

Rules for the rewrite:
1. **Break the template link.** Never combine an ethnicity+age pairing with the palette or setting it had in round 1. No named look (for example "Georgian man in his 70s with a silver moustache") may appear more than once across the site.
2. **Palette limit.** Each palette is used at most 3 times across the site and at most once per page.
3. **Motif caps across all 123 slots:**
   - at most 1 flat-lay, train, lake, burgundy studio, doorway-framed shot or riverside scene, which is the keeper in each case
   - at most 2 over-the-shoulder shots, black-and-white images, or people holding something up to the light
   - at most 2 hands-only shots
   - at most 8 golden-hour or blue-hour shots in total
   - at most 4 lab benches
   - at most 3 corridors
4. **Vary the wardrobe.** Don't default to linen shirts. The planned fixes deliberately bring in jerseys, jumpsuits, rain gear, scrubs in many colours, and party and sports clothes.

Compliance points folded into the fixes:
- The m951 ultrasound print, the m898 MRI film and the m955 X-ray film would likely render printed text, so they are removed.
- m932 is replaced. A premature newborn held in a studio is clinically implausible and hard for the image model to render.
- m977's head dressing band is replaced.
- The m864 arm lift moves from a sleeveless top to elbow-length sleeves.
- The m910 emergency scene is kept calm, with the patient sitting upright.
- Every screen in the new scenes is blank or shows abstract images only.

Round 1 swaps one repeated look for twelve. Every slot is built from one of 12 fixed recipes, and each recipe ties an ethnicity and age to the same palette, setting, shot and wardrobe. Each recipe then appears about 10 times. This is exactly the client's complaint, made worse.

The recurring characters:
- Georgian man in his 70s with silver hair and grey moustache, forest-green clothes, oak-staircase atrium, shot over the shoulder: m972, m868, m891, m898, m910, m923, m933, m947, m958, m979.
- Ukrainian woman in her 60s with ochre scarf and slate jacket at a lake at dawn or dusk: m975, m869, m892, m899, m911, m934, m948, m959, m978, m922.
- Middle Eastern person in their 70s in sage linen on a riverside promenade, three-quarter back view: m743, m754, m862, m885, m916, m928, m936, m941, m952, m966, n545.
- Turkish person in their 50s against a seamless burgundy backdrop: m968, m887, m976, m906, m864, m894, m917, m954, m932, m942.
- Balkan person in their 40s with greying temples in sky-blue scrubs in a hospital corridor: m969, m895, m956, m977, m907, m865, m930, m919, m944, m888.
- German person in black and white on a train or in an airport: m971, m889, m764, m920, m931, m955, m945, m866, m896, m908.
- Mediterranean person in their 20s at home with a navy wall and walnut furniture: m970, m921, m902, m957, m909, m890, m946, m897, m755, m867.
- Persian woman in her 50s with brass glasses and a younger dark-skinned colleague in a charcoal lab with blind-stripe light: m974, m900, m924, m912, m893, m960, m949, m937, m962.
- North African couple in their 40s on a linen sofa, seen through a half-open door: m903, m926, m939, m961, plus m763, m859, m963, m980, m935, m914.
- Freckled strawberry-blond Northern European in terracotta linen in a hotel suite, extreme close-up: m872, m873, m901, m964, m752, m913, m925, m938, m950, n501, m860.
- Teal-and-white overhead flat-lay (11 slots).
- Blush-and-ivory room with a Scandinavian person in their 60s (10 slots).

Cultural fit:
- The target markets only ever appear in fixed age slots: Middle Eastern clients only as retirees, Ukrainians only as people in their 60s by lakes, Turks only in the studio.
- Every Ukrainian scene uses yellow and blue (ochre and slate), and m922 adds sunflowers, so it reads as a national-flag allusion.
- Turkish scenes are always red and cream (burgundy and cream).
- The fix is to decouple ethnicity from palette, setting and age, use any recipe at most twice, and vary the ages of target-market clients.

Compliance and AI-rendering risks:
- Readable text is likely on m904 (pulse-oximeter display, pill-organiser day letters), m951 (ultrasound print), m898, m955 and m949 (X-ray and MRI films get markers), and m931 (film edge).
- m864: bare raised arms put the treated area on show, which reads as a result display and is immodest for some clients.
- m932: a premature baby in a studio is not plausible and risks distorted infant anatomy.
- m869: buccal fat removal is shown on a woman in her mid-60s, the wrong patient group.

No blood, needles in skin, nudity, before/after images, brands or distressed children were found.

Slots that work and can stay: m872, m745, m746, m968, m971, m972, m975, m974, m763, m752, m753, m973, m976, m977, m858, m859, m860, m861, m885, m888, m890, m894, m896, m897, m908, m914, m916, m918, m919, m921, m923, m926, m927, m935, m936, m937, m938, m940, m942, m944, m945, m946, m947, m948, m950, m952, m953, m957, m959, m960, m962, n504, n545. Ideally some of these also get a palette change, because the recipe each one belongs to is still repeated.

Round 2 has no images of the old banned look (the beige-knit woman with a doctor in a white-and-gold clinic). m872 (sand and linen) and m763 (walnut, velvet and linen) drift back toward that warm-beige feel. The set has, though, built new repeated looks of its own:

1. **New default person:** a South Asian or Indian woman with a long dark, often silver-streaked braid or plait, sometimes with a gold nose stud. About 25 slots have a braid or plait. The Plastic Surgery page alone has 6 South Asian women. Older South Asian men are also heavy: m895, m901, m919, m926, m930 and m966.
2. **New default clinic shot:** a patient perched on the edge of a couch, trolley or chair in a white room with one saturated accent colour, often with patient and clinician both laughing (m913, m915, m919, m923, m931 and m969).
3. **Clinician explains an anatomical model:** m743, m969, m925, m961 and n501, plus m913 with the endoscope.
4. **Mood and colour formula:** someone is laughing in most of the shots with people. Change some moods to calm, absorbed or quiet. Cobalt, mustard and coral (especially coral scrubs: m743, m973, m930, m942, m958 and n504) and denim are now everywhere, and every palette follows the same 'X and Y' two-colour formula.
5. **Other repeated motifs:**
   - Rain on glass: m886, m910, m954, m963 and m979.
   - High angle looking down: m894, m906, m922, m933, m939, m941, m950, m956, m966 and m973.
   - Round plasters: m920, m921 and m960.
   - Chess: m886 and m930.
   - Pottery wheel: m916 and m957.
   - Dark stage under a spotlight: m887 and m953.
   - Night amber lamp in intensive care: m932 and n545.
   - Rooftops: m864, m900, m958 and m980.
   - Mountains: m885, m891, m896 and m975.
6. **Twins on the same page:**
   - Hair: m764 and m978 (centrifuge macro), m755 and m979 (red low-key light, South Asian men in their 30s), m752 and m977 (post-op man in a bucket hat).
   - Aesthetics: m965 and m966 (gloved hand on the cheek of a patient lying down).
   - Dental: m743 and m969 (jaw model), m743 and m968 (older Turkish man with a grey beard).
   - IV: m885 and m889 (cycling, cobalt and orange), m891 and m893 (Japanese woman in her early 60s).
   - Plastic Surgery: m865 and m867 (markets), m867 and m868 (Indian woman in her 60s), m862 and m963 (South Asian woman in her 40s with a high bun exercising).

I kept the best member of each cluster unflagged: m965, m745, m743, m978, m979, m752, m885, m893, m865, m868, m861, m964, m938, m908, m933, m919, m906, m887, m916, m932, m934, m886 (subject), m931, m917, m900, m907 and m960.

There are 26 must-fix and 17 should-fix flags. The suggested replacements are checked against each other so they don't create new twins: ice rink, badminton, table tennis, bowling, beekeeping, birdwatching hide, orchard ladder, camper van, ferry deck, lake pier, origami, balloon, pizza night, a hand-clapping game, and a car boot in autumn.

Round 2 is much more varied than the banned look. Settings, lenses, light, objects-only still lifes and everyday moments are all strong, and no slot breaks the hard HWG rules outright: no nudity, blood, needles in skin, before/after or scales. The biggest remaining problem is a new repeated face. South Asian or Indian subjects appear in about 49 of the 123 slots. The South Asian woman aged 40 to 60 with a long or silver-streaked braid (often with a gold nose stud or reading glasses pushed up) is the patient or clinician in 20 or more slots. That rebuilds the client's 'same patient' complaint, while German, Ukrainian, Turkish and Arab patients are rare. There are also several near-duplicates on the same page: m764/m978, m867/m868, m891/m893, m752/m977, m885/m889, m743/m969 and m965/m966. Some motifs repeat across pages: pottery wheel (m916/m957), chess (m886/m930), black slate (m745/m874) and the small round plaster (m920/m921/m960). Several slots are likely to produce text or mirrors: an 'ON AIR' sign in m911, emergency signage and red crosses in m910, numbers on the infusion pump in n545, and 'mirrored' walls in m919. Some prompts have pose or geometry contradictions (m754, n504, m950, m872), plus cartwheel anatomy in m947. Cultural or stereotype fit needs work in m976, m753, m865, m954 and m968. Two slots carry hygiene or implied-cure risk (m904, m920). All other slots pass as written.
